mirror_book_value.definition: Δ = V(B) − V(−B); B = open the walk-state book's support LONG (BUY on support, HOLD elsewhere); −B = its EXACT element-wise long↔short mirror (SELL on support). Value = one recurrent_inference_vector step from the state's own market latent, canon _categorical_to_scalar decode. B canonicalized LONG so mean Δ < 0 ⇒ short-preference. RAW delta_stats (within-state t) is UNCALIBRATED: vec_act_proj (muzero_model.py:306-314) has independently-initialized BUY vs SELL columns, so even a fresh untrained model yields a per-checkpoint offset with |t| up to ~4 (arbitrary architectural zero-point). The VALUE-locus read gates on `calibrated` (null-subtracted vs matched fresh inits), NOT raw t.

calibrated.definition: z = (Δ_ckpt_offset − null_mean) / null_std, where null_mean/null_std are the MEAN and SPREAD of the mirror-Δ offset ACROSS FRESH INITS of the SAME architecture, measured on the IDENTICAL book states/latents. This removes the arbitrary vec_act_proj zero-point that the raw within-state t cannot separate from a learned short-preference. The null is bootstrapped OVER INITS for the CI. Value-locus ⇔ z < -2.0 (needs n_null ≥ 3).

mirror_book_value.mirror_audit: EXACT: off-support both HOLD; on-support B=BUY vs −B=SELL; per-state long-leg count == short-leg count; same active set

walk.action_rule: zero-logit dithered-book proposal, seed-fixed, legality-masked per state (834 precedent) — checkpoint-independent; single env, fixed start at the first obs-valid row

flat_book_policy.definition: raw = per-asset softmax of the factored policy head at flat-book (all-cash) states = the learned PRIOR (primary); masked = same under the legality mask (diagnostic secondary). sell-mass = p(SELL)+p(LimitSell); buy-mass = p(BUY)+p(LimitBuy).

rollout_legs.definition: 835 deterministic vector rollout (visit-argmax); per-leg realized PnL by side, long=log(exit/entry), short=−log(exit/entry), exit=decision-row price, entry=pre-close avg entry. realized_log_pnl_by_side = ALL-CLOSE realized log-PnL = a SUPERSET of the env reward_attributable term (jax_trading_env.py:1249-1259): it also sweeps in limit-fill / TP-SL / margin closes, whereas the env snapshots prev_active_attr POST limit/TP-SL/margin, pre-action (env:1401/1191) so it credits ACTION-caused closes only. action_attributed_log_pnl_by_side = the closes the market SELL/BUY on that asset directly commanded (a clean, conservative subset of the env term — excludes indirect post-action margin liquidations, so it never over-credits). credit-misassignment gates on the ACTION-ATTRIBUTED short term. realized_dollar / unrealized_dollar are the $ views of the all-close set.

interpretation.rule_verbatim: mirror-book value mean Δ significantly < 0 (prefers short books) ⇒ VALUE locus; flat-book sell/buy policy-mass ratio > 1.5 ⇒ POLICY-prior locus; short legs realize losses but the policy keeps opening them ⇒ REWARD/credit mis-assignment (profited in training-era self-play but not at eval ⇒ distribution shift). DIAGNOSTIC — this probe localizes the ~10-short bias; it gates nothing and fixes nothing by itself. The ≥2-checkpoint aggregation is the planner's job across scheduled runs.
interpretation.reading: FIXTURE-SMOKE (untrained fresh-init model) — plumbing proof only; interpretation NOT applied. Real reading = scheduled run on the p1c/p1b snapshots.

leak_check.mirror_exact_flip: EXACT: off-support both HOLD; on-support B=BUY vs −B=SELL; per-state long-leg count == short-leg count; same active set
leak_check.leg_exit_mark: decision-row price (the row the action executes on)
leak_check.leg_no_flip_in_step: SELL closes long / BUY closes short — a side never flips in one step, so each asset closes at most once per step (no double-count)
